title.narrative: Humanitarian response to the critical needs of war-affected people in preparation for wintertime, 2024-2025

description.narrative: ltpgtAs Ukraine continues to face the devastating impacts of ongoing conflict, the upcoming winter of 2024–2025 presents severe additional challenges for vulnerable populations, particularly in the Chernihiv, Dnipro, Donetsk, Zaporizhzhia, and Odesa regions. The situation remains dire for millions of war-affected Ukrainians, exacerbated by extensive energy shortages due to attacks on infrastructure. This project aims to provide urgent, multisectoral lifesaving assistance to internally displaced persons (IDPs), war-affected households, and collective sites, ensuring they can endure the harsh winter conditions. The project will support long-term resilience by providing cash assistance for increased winter utility bills, a sufficient amount of solid fuel to stay warm, and heating appliances, ensuring safe access to basic services in the collective sites during wintertime.ltbrgtThe project components include cash assistance for utility bills, provision of solid fuel, distribution of heating appliances, and support for collective sites. Providing cash grants to cover increased winter utility bills helps alleviate the financial burden on vulnerable households, ensuring they can maintain heating and other essential services during the winter months. Distribution of solid fuel directly to households ensures that families have the necessary resources to keep warm. Supplying heating appliances to vulnerable households enhances their ability to stay warm and safe, including stoves and other necessary equipment to utilize the provided solid fuel efficiently.nbspMobile teams will register beneficiaries, ensuring those with limited mobility are included by providing home registration services.ltbrgtFor collective sites in Zaporizhzhia, Ivano-Frankivsk, and Lviv regions, the project will strengthen existing teams with funds for repairs and procurement. This includes insulation works, replacement of heating system, procurement of solid fuelnbspand ensuring the collective sites are energy-efficient and ready for winter.ltbrgtThe project emphasizes coordination with local authorities and existing humanitarian frameworks.lt/pgtltpgtLocal contractors will be prioritized to stimulate the local economy and ensure timely delivery of services. Protection principles are embedded in all project activities. Contractors will receive training on Protection from Sexual Exploitation and Abuse (PSEA) and Gender-Based Violence (GBV) guidelines. The project ensures equitable access to services for all beneficiaries, including those with disabilities and elderly individuals.ltbrgtlt/pgt
